text: Currently, Trowell Avenue, from Keele Street to Kane Avenue, has no speed humps. The following motion will have to be submitted. The drawing is attached.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the Director, Transportation Services, Etobicoke York District, to request the City Clerk to survey eligible householders in English or any other language specified by Community Council, on Trowell Avenue, from Keele Street to Kane Avenue, to determine if property owners/occupants support the installation, according to the City of Toronto Traffic Calming Policy. 2. Subject to favourable results of the survey: a. Requested the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Trowell Avenue, from Keele Street to Kane Avenue, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on Drawing EY18-073.DGN, dated June 2018 and circulated to residents during the polling process. b. Directed Transportation Services take to the necessary actions to reduce the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Trowell Avenue, from Keele Street…
